Currently, vLLM v1 scheduling enables ChunkPrefill/SplitFuse by default, which means:\n" +" - (1) If the input length of a request is greater than `--max-num-batched-tokens`, it will be divided into multiple rounds of computation according to `--max-num-batched-tokens`;\n" +" - (2) Decode requests are prioritized for scheduling, and prefill requests are scheduled only if there is available capacity.\n" +" - Generally, if `--max-num-batched-tokens` is set to a larger value, the overall latency will be lower, but the pressure on HBM memory (activation value usage) will be greater.\n" +" - `--gpu-memory-utilization` represents the proportion of HBM that vLLM will use for actual inference. Its essential function is to calculate the available kv_cache size. During the warm-up phase (referred to as profile run in vLLM), vLLM records the peak HBM memory usage during an inference process with an input size of `--max-num-batched-tokens`. The available kv_cache size is then calculated as: `--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM size - peak HBM memory usage. Therefore, the larger the value of `--gpu-memory-utilization`, the more kv_cache can be used. However, since the HBM memory usage during the warm-up phase may differ from that during actual inference (e.g., due to uneven EP load), setting `--gpu-memory-utilization` too high may lead to OOM (Out of Memory) issues during actual inference. The default value is `0.9`.\n" +" - `--no-enable-prefix-caching` disables prefix caching in the example above. For workloads with long shared prefixes, finer-grained hybrid prefix matching can be enabled with `--enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 16`. The match unit must divide every KV cache group's block size. A smaller unit can reuse more of a partial physical page, at the cost of additional hash metadata, copy-on-write operations, and an extra prefill split at the final matching boundary.\n" +" - `--quantization ascend` indicates that quantization is used. To disable quantization, remove this option.\n" +" - `--speculative-config` uses `qwen3_5_mtp` for both `Qwen3.5-27B` and `Qwen3.6-27B` because they share the same MTP head design.\n" +" - `--compilation-config` contains configurations related to the aclgraph graph mode. The most significant configurations are `\"cudagraph_mode\"` and `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`, which have the following meanings:\n" +" - `\"cudagraph_mode\"`: represents the specific graph mode. Currently, `\"PIECEWISE\"` and `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"` are supported. The graph mode is mainly used to reduce the cost of operator dispatch. Currently, `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"` is recommended.\n" +" - `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`: represents different levels of graph modes. The default value is `[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40,..., --max-num-seqs]`. In the graph mode, the input for graphs at different levels is fixed, and inputs between levels are automatically padded to the next level. Currently, the default setting is recommended. Only in some scenarios is it necessary to set this separately to achieve optimal performance." +msgstr "" +"- `--data-parallel-size 1` 和 `--tensor-parallel-size 2` 是数据并行（DP）和张量并行（TP）规模的常见设置。\n" +" - `--max-model-len` 表示上下文长度，即单个请求的输入加输出的最大值。Qwen3.6-27B 模型最高支持 262144。\n" +" - `--max-num-seqs` 表示每个 DP 组允许处理的最大请求数。如果发送到服务的请求数超过此限制，超出的请求将保持等待状态，不会被调度。请注意，等待状态所花费的时间也会计入 TTFT 和 TPOT 等指标。因此，在测试性能时，通常建议 `--max-num-seqs` * `--data-parallel-size` >= 实际总并发数。\n" +" - `--max-num-batched-tokens` 表示模型在单步中能够处理的最大 token 数。目前，vLLM v1 调度默认启用 ChunkPrefill/SplitFuse，这意味着：\n" +" - (1) 如果某个请求的输入长度大于 `--max-num-batched-tokens`，将按照 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 分成多轮计算；\n" +" - (2) Decode 请求优先调度，只有在有可用容量时才会调度 prefill 请求。\n" +" - 通常，如果将 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 设置为较大的值，整体时延会更低，但对 HBM 内存（激活值占用）的压力会更大。\n" +" - `--gpu-memory-utilization` 表示 vLLM 将用于实际推理的 HBM 比例。其核心作用是计算可用的 kv_cache 大小。在预热阶段（在 vLLM 中称为 profile run），vLLM 会记录输入大小为 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 的一次推理过程中的 HBM 内存峰值占用。可用的 kv_cache 大小随后计算为：`--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM 大小 - HBM 内存峰值占用。因此，`--gpu-memory-utilization` 的值越大，可使用的 kv_cache 就越多。然而，由于预热阶段的 HBM 内存占用可能与实际推理时不同（例如由于 EP 负载不均衡），将 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 设置得过高可能会导致实际推理时出现 OOM（Out of Memory）问题。默认值为 `0.9`。\n" +" - `--no-enable-prefix-caching` 在上例中禁用前缀缓存。对于具有长共享前缀的工作负载，可以通过 `--enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 16` 启用更细粒度的混合前缀匹配。匹配单元必须能整除每个 KV cache 组的 block size。更小的单元可以复用更多部分物理页，代价是额外的哈希元数据、写时复制操作，以及在最终匹配边界处额外的一次 prefill 拆分。\n" +" - `--quantization ascend` 表示使用量化。要禁用量化，请移除该选项。\n" +" - `--speculative-config` 对 `Qwen3.5-27B` 和 `Qwen3.6-27B` 均使用 `qwen3_5_mtp`，因为它们共享相同的 MTP head 设计。\n" +" - `--compilation-config` 包含与 aclgraph 图模式相关的配置。最重要的配置是 `\"cudagraph_mode\"` 和 `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`，其含义如下：\n" +" - `\"cudagraph_mode\"`：表示具体的图模式。目前支持 `\"PIECEWISE\"` 和 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。图模式主要用于降低算子分发开销。目前推荐使用 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。\n" +" - `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`：表示不同层级的图模式。默认值为 `[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40,..., --max-num-seqs]`。在图模式下，不同层级图的输入是固定的，层级之间的输入会自动填充到下一层级。目前推荐使用默认设置。只有在某些场景下才需要单独设置此项以达到最优性能。" + +msgid "" +"The following example is for 950DT Products. HBM 内存峰值占用。因此，`--gpu-memory-utilization` 的值越大，可使用的 kv_cache 就越多。但是，由于预热阶段的 HBM 内存占用可能与实际推理时不同（例如 EP 负载不均衡），将 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 设置得过高可能会导致实际推理时出现 OOM（Out of Memory，内存不足）问题。默认值为 `0.9`。\n" +" - `--quantization ascend` 表示使用量化。要禁用量化，请移除该选项。\n" +" - `--enable-prefix-caching` 启用自动前缀缓存。\n" +" - `--speculative-config` 对 `Qwen3.8-27B` 使用 `qwen3_5_mtp`，因为它与 `Qwen3.5-27B` 共享相同的 MTP head 设计。\n" +" - `--compilation-config` 包含与 aclgraph 图模式相关的配置。最重要的配置是 `\"cudagraph_mode\"` 和 `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`，其含义如下：\n" +" - `\"cudagraph_mode\"`：表示具体的图模式。目前支持 `\"PIECEWISE\"` 和 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。图模式主要用于降低算子分发开销。目前推荐使用 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。\n" +" - `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`：表示不同层级的图模式。默认值为 `[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40,..., --max-num-seqs]`。在图模式下，不同层级的图输入是固定的，层级之间的输入会自动填充到下一层级。目前推荐使用默认设置。仅在某些场景下需要单独设置此项以达到最优性能。\n" +" - A " +"successful startup includes output similar to the following:" +msgstr "等待引擎完成权重加载和图捕获。成功启动会包含类似以下的输出：" + +msgid "### 7.1 Using AISBench" +msgstr "### 7.1 使用 AISBench" + +msgid "### 8.1 Using AISBench" +msgstr "### 8.1 使用 AISBench" + +msgid "### 8.2 Using vLLM Benchmark" +msgstr "### 8.2 使用 vLLM Benchmark"

+msgid "# Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Experimental)"
+msgstr "# Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（实验性）"
+
+msgid "## 1 Introduction"
+msgstr "## 1 简介"
+
+msgid ""
+"Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model and an "
+"experimental preview of the architecture that will underpin Qwen4. Its "
+"language model combines Gated DeltaNet and Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA), "
+"gated residual connections, Position Learning Enhancement (PLE), and a "
+"native Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) head."
+msgstr ""
+"Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 是一款多模态混合专家（MoE）模型，也是支撑 Qwen4 架构的实验性预览版本。其语言模型融合了 Gated "
+"DeltaNet 与 Qwen Sparse Attention（QSA）、门控残差连接、位置学习增强（PLE）以及原生多 Token "
+"预测（MTP）头。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The current version supports only Atlas A3 series hardware. Atlas A2 series "
+"hardware and Ascend 950DT and 950PR products are not yet supported and will "
+"be enabled progressively in future releases. This tutorial describes the "
+"W8A8 deployment on Atlas 800 A3. Text and multimodal input have been "
+"validated on Atlas 800 A3."
+msgstr ""
+"当前版本仅支持 Atlas A3系列产品硬件。Atlas A2系列产品硬件以及 Ascend 950DT 和 950PR "
+"系列产品暂不支持，将在后续版本中逐步开放。本教程介绍在 Atlas 800 A3 上的 W8A8 部署。文本和多模态输入已在 Atlas 800 A3 "
+"上完成验证。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This document is validated and written based on **vLLM-Ascend 0.26.0rc "
+"release**. The current model (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) is first supported in this"
+" version."
+msgstr ""
+"本文档基于 **vLLM-Ascend 0.26.0rc 版本**进行验证和编写。当前模型（Qwen3.8-Flash-"
+"Next）在该版本中首次获得支持。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Automatic Prefix Caching is experimental for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. Enable it\n"
+"    with `--enable-prefix-caching --mamba-cache-mode align` and revalidate NPU\n"
+"    memory capacity for the target context length and concurrency."
+msgstr ""
+"自动前缀缓存（Automatic Prefix Caching）在 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 上属于实验性功能。可通过\n"
+"    `--enable-prefix-caching --mamba-cache-mode align` 启用，并针对目标上下文长度和并发量\n"
+"    重新验证 NPU 内存容量。"
+
+msgid "## 2 Supported Features"
+msgstr "## 2 支持的特性"
+
+msgid ""
+"Refer to [supported "

+msgstr ""

+
+msgid ""
+"Refer to [Feature Guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/index.md) to get "
+"feature configuration details."
+msgstr "请参阅[特性指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/index.md)以获取特性配置详情。"
+
+msgid "## 3 Prerequisites"
+msgstr "## 3 前提条件"
+
+msgid "### 3.1 Model Weight"
+msgstr "### 3.1 模型权重"
+
+msgid "The following model weights are available:"
+msgstr "可用的模型权重如下："
+
+msgid ""
+"- `Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-w8a8-mtp` (Quantized version): requires 1 Atlas 800 A3"
+" (64GB × 8) node. [https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/Qwen3.8-Flash-"
+"Next-w8a8-mtp](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/Qwen3.8-Flash-"
+"Next-w8a8-mtp)"
+msgstr ""
+"- `Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-w8a8-mtp`（量化版本）：需要 1 个 Atlas 800 A3（64GB × "
+"8）节点。[https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/Qwen3.8-Flash-"
+"Next-w8a8-mtp](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/Qwen3.8-Flash-"
+"Next-w8a8-mtp)"
+
+msgid ""
+"It is recommended to download the model weight to the shared directory of "
+"multiple nodes, such as /root/.cache/."
+msgstr "建议将模型权重下载到多节点的共享目录中，例如 /root/.cache/。"
+
+msgid "## 4 Installation"
+msgstr "## 4 安装"
+
+msgid "### 4.1 Docker Image Installation"
+msgstr "### 4.1 Docker 镜像安装"
+
+msgid ""
+"The pre-built images listed below have been validated for this tutorial."

+"- Ubuntu：`quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:qwen3.8-next-a3`"

+msgid "=== \"A3 series\""
+msgstr "=== \"A3系列产品\""

+msgid "## 5 Online Service Deployment {: #5-online-service-deployment }"
+msgstr "## 5 在线服务部署 {: #5-online-service-deployment }"
+
+msgid "### 5.1 Single-Node Online Deployment"
+msgstr "### 5.1 单节点在线部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"For single-node online deployment on Atlas 800 A3, the following DP1 × TP8 "
+"command was validated with an Ascend-compatible W8A8 checkpoint. It enables "
+"QSA Lightning Indexer, QSA Expand E3, MTP speculative decoding, Function "
+"Calling, and reasoning parsing."
+msgstr ""
+"针对 Atlas 800 A3 上的单节点在线部署，以下 DP1 × TP8 命令已使用昇腾兼容的 W8A8 权重完成验证。该命令启用了 QSA "
+"Lightning Indexer、QSA Expand E3、MTP 投机推理、Function Calling 以及推理内容解析。"
+
+msgid "Before starting the service:"
+msgstr "启动服务之前："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Replace `MODEL_PATH` with the directory recorded when downloading the model weight.\n"
+"- Revalidate memory capacity before changing the context length, concurrency, or memory utilization."
+msgstr ""
+"- 将 `MODEL_PATH` 替换为下载模型权重时记录的目录。\n"
+"- 在更改上下文长度、并发量或内存利用率之前，请重新验证内存容量。"
+
+msgid "=== \"A3 series\""
+msgstr "=== \"A3系列产品\""
+
+msgid "The following example is for Atlas 800 A3."
+msgstr "以下示例适用于 Atlas 800 A3。"
+
+msgid "Key parameter descriptions:"
+msgstr "关键参数说明："
+
+msgid ""
+"- `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_QSA_LIGHTNING_INDEXER=1` enables the fused QSA Lightning Indexer path.\n"
+"    - `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_QSA_E3V=1` enables the fused QSA Expand E3 path.\n"
+"    - `--quantization ascend` loads the Ascend-compatible W8A8 checkpoint.\n"
+"    - `--tensor-parallel-size 8` and `--data-parallel-size 1` configure the A3 single-DP TP8 topology.\n"
+"    - `--enable-expert-parallel` enables expert parallelism for the MoE layers.\n"
+"    - `--enable-prefix-caching --mamba-cache-mode align` enables Prefix Caching with aligned GDN and PLE state checkpoints.\n"
+"    - The validated command does not set `--language-model-only`, so the vision encoder remains enabled and the service accepts both text and multimodal requests. For a text-only deployment, you may add `--language-model-only` to skip loading the vision encoder.\n"
+"    - `--enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml` enables automatic Function Calling with the Qwen3 XML parser.\n"
+"    - `--reasoning-parser qwen3` separates reasoning from the final answer in the OpenAI-compatible response.\n"
+"    - `--speculative-config` uses the model's MTP head to draft three tokens. `enforce_eager=true` keeps the MTP proposer in eager mode.\n"
+"    - `--compilation-config` enables `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` ACLGraph for decode.\n"
+"    - `fuse_norm_quant=false` selects the validated norm and quantization path for this W8A8 deployment."
+msgstr ""
+"- `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_QSA_LIGHTNING_INDEXER=1` 启用融合的 QSA Lightning Indexer 路径。\n"
+"    - `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_QSA_E3V=1` 启用融合的 QSA Expand E3 路径。\n"
+"    - `--quantization ascend` 加载昇腾兼容的 W8A8 权重。\n"
+"    - `--tensor-parallel-size 8` 和 `--data-parallel-size 1` 配置 A3 单 DP TP8 拓扑。\n"
+"    - `--enable-expert-parallel` 为 MoE 层启用专家并行。\n"
+"    - `--enable-prefix-caching --mamba-cache-mode align` 启用 Prefix Caching，并对齐 GDN 和 PLE 状态检查点。\n"
+"    - 已验证的命令未设置 `--language-model-only`，因此视觉编码器保持启用，服务可同时接受文本和多模态请求。若仅需文本部署，可添加 `--language-model-only` 以跳过加载视觉编码器。\n"
+"    - `--enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml` 启用自动 Function Calling，并使用 Qwen3 XML 解析器。\n"
+"    - `--reasoning-parser qwen3` 在 OpenAI 兼容响应中将推理内容与最终答案分离。\n"

 msgid ""

+"recomputation) are not supported with batch invariance."
+msgstr "批处理不变性不支持分块预填充（chunked prefill）、前缀缓存（prefix caching）以及请求抢占（驱逐和重新计算）。"
+
+msgid ""
+"These scheduling features are not disabled automatically. You must "
+"explicitly disable chunked prefill and prefix caching in your configuration,"
+" and pair the chunked prefill disabling with a KV cache block size of 128 — "
+"pass `--block-size 128` together with `--no-enable-chunked-prefill` when "
+"starting the server, or `block_size=128` together with "
+"`enable_chunked_prefill=False` for offline inference — as shown in the "
+"examples above."
 msgstr ""
-"- 支持更多 NPU 系列\n"
-"- 扩展模型覆盖范围\n"

+"这些调度特性不会被自动禁用。你必须在配置中显式禁用分块预填充和前缀缓存，并将禁用分块预填充与 KV 缓存块大小 128 搭配使用——启动服务时同时传入 "
+"`--block-size 128` 和 `--no-enable-chunked-prefill`，离线推理时同时设置 "
+"`block_size=128` 和 `enable_chunked_prefill=False`——如上述示例所示。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Request preemption is triggered when the KV cache runs out: the preempted "
+"request is evicted and recomputed later. The recomputed prefill includes the"
+" tokens generated before the preemption, so attention processes them through"
+" the prefill (P) path instead of the original decode (D) path — the P and D "
+"computations cannot be aligned, which breaks batch invariance. To reduce the"
+" chance of preemption, increase the available KV cache or lower the per-"
+"request and concurrent pressure:"
+msgstr ""
+"当 KV 缓存耗尽时会触发请求抢占：被抢占的请求会被驱逐并在稍后重新计算。重新计算的预填充包含抢占之前生成的 "
+"token，因此注意力机制会通过预填充（P）路径而非原本的解码（D）路径处理这些 token——P 和 D "
+"的计算无法对齐，从而破坏批处理不变性。为降低抢占发生的概率，可增加可用的 KV 缓存，或降低单请求及并发压力："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Decrease `--max-num-seqs` so fewer requests share the KV cache.\n"
+"- Set `--max-model-len` to the smallest value your workload needs, and cap the per-request output length (`max_tokens`).\n"
+"- Increase `--gpu-memory-utilization` to leave more memory for the KV cache."
+msgstr ""
+"- 减小 `--max-num-seqs`，使更少的请求共享 KV 缓存。\n"
+"- 将 `--max-model-len` 设置为你的工作负载所需的最小值，并限制单请求的输出长度（`max_tokens`）。\n"
+"- 提高 `--gpu-memory-utilization`，为 KV 缓存留出更多内存。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the startup logs (`GPU KV cache size` and `Maximum concurrency for ... "
+"tokens per request`) to size your workload against the KV cache capacity, "
+"and watch the engine stats: `GPU KV cache usage` approaching 100% signals "
+"imminent preemption. See the [preemption FAQ](../../faqs.md#22-why-does-"
+"tpot-increase-drastically-as-concurrency-grows) for details."
+msgstr ""
+"使用启动日志（`GPU KV cache size` 和 `Maximum concurrency for ... tokens per "
+"request`）根据 KV 缓存容量来规划你的工作负载，并关注引擎统计信息：`GPU KV cache usage` 接近 100% "
+"表示即将发生抢占。详情请参阅[抢占常见问题](../../faqs.md#22-why-does-tpot-increase-drastically-"
+"as-concurrency-grows)。"

-"On Ascend 950, CPU binding uses NPU-to-CPU affinity from `npu-smi info -t topo`\n"
+"On 950PR&950DT Products, CPU binding uses NPU-to-CPU affinity from `npu-smi info -t topo`\n"

-"`Thread(s) per core`: 8 CPUs when it is 1, and 16 CPUs when it is 2. Ascend 950\n"

 "constrained by the current cpuset. In Docker deployments, add `--pid=host` when\n"
 "creating the container so vLLM Ascend can discover and bind these host threads.\n"
-"Ascend 950 still can migrate memory pages when `migratepages` is available, but\n"

 "config '{\"ascend_compilation_config\": {\"enable_npugraph_ex\":false}}'。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Graph mode is currently available on both Model Runner V1/V2.\n"
+"- **ACLGraph** (capture/replay via `torch.npu.NPUGraph`) is the runtime graph execution mechanism used by the default graph path on Ascend.\n"
+"- **Npugraph_ex** is a compile-time FX graph optimization layer, enabled by default in FULL/FULL_DECODE_ONLY modes. It optimizes the graph before ACLGraph captures it.\n"
+"- **XliteGraph** is an optional graph path for selected model families and environments.\n"
+"- In context parallel scenarios, `cudagraph_mode=\"FULL\"` is not sufficiently supported yet."
+msgstr ""
+"- 图模式目前可在 Model Runner V1/V2 上使用。\n"
+"- **ACLGraph**（通过 `torch.npu.NPUGraph` 进行捕获/重放）是昇腾上默认图路径所使用的运行时图执行机制。\n"
+"- **Npugraph_ex** 是编译期的 FX 图优化层，在 FULL/FULL_DECODE_ONLY 模式下默认启用。它在 ACLGraph 捕获图之前对图进行优化。\n"
+"- **XliteGraph** 是针对特定模型系列和环境可选使用的图路径。\n"
+"- 在上下文并行场景中，`cudagraph_mode=\"FULL\"` 尚未得到充分支持。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Ascend sets `use_inductor=False` and selects its own compilation backend. "
+"That backend applies npugraph_ex optimizations or FX fusion passes according"
+" to the configuration."
+msgstr ""
+"昇腾会设置 `use_inductor=False` 并选择自己的编译后端。该后端会根据配置应用 npugraph_ex 优化或 FX 融合 pass。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Npugraph_ex is **enabled by default** on supported hardware when "
+"`cudagraph_mode` is `FULL` or `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`. It is automatically "
+"disabled in `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE`, `PIECEWISE`, and `NONE` modes."
+msgstr ""
+"在支持的硬件上，当 `cudagraph_mode` 为 `FULL` 或 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 时，Npugraph_ex "
+"**默认启用**。在 `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE`、`PIECEWISE` 和 `NONE` 模式下，它会自动禁用。"
+
+msgid "Select a full graph mode to use this default:"
+msgstr "选择一种完整图模式以使用此默认配置："
+
+msgid "### Super Kernel optimization"
+msgstr "### Super Kernel 优化"
+
+msgid ""
+"[Super "
+"Kernel](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/Pytorch/latest/devguide/TorchAir/docs/zh/npugraph_ex/advanced/superkernel.md)"
+" is an **optional** operator-binary fusion optimization. Unlike source-level"
+" fusion, it works on compiled kernel binaries: eligible subgraphs are "
+"identified, their child kernels are combined into a larger kernel, and "
+"synchronization is inserted according to graph dependencies. Compared with "
+"launching operators individually, this can reduce task scheduling waits, "
+"launch overhead, and operator-head overhead."
+msgstr ""
+"[Super "
+"Kernel](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/Pytorch/latest/devguide/TorchAir/docs/zh/npugraph_ex/advanced/superkernel.md)"
+" 是一种**可选**的算子二进制融合优化。与源码级融合不同，它作用于编译后的 kernel 二进制：识别符合条件的子图，将其子 kernel "
+"合并为一个更大的 kernel，并根据图依赖关系插入同步。与逐个启动算子相比，这可以减少任务调度等待、启动开销和算子头开销。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In vLLM Ascend, Super Kernel optimization is applied during ACLGraph "
+"capture. It depends on both static kernel and Npugraph_ex:"
+msgstr ""
+"在 vLLM Ascend 中，Super Kernel 优化在 ACLGraph 捕获期间应用。它同时依赖 static kernel 和 "
+"Npugraph_ex："
+
+msgid ""
+"Static kernel is disabled by default, so Super Kernel is also disabled under"
+" the default configuration. When `enable_static_kernel` is explicitly set to"
+" `true` and `enable_super_kernel` is omitted, Super Kernel follows static "
+"kernel and is enabled. Set `enable_super_kernel` explicitly to override this"
+" inherited behavior. Super Kernel cannot be enabled when static kernel is "
+"disabled."
+msgstr ""
+"static kernel 默认禁用，因此在默认配置下 Super Kernel 也处于禁用状态。当 `enable_static_kernel` "
+"显式设置为 `true` 且省略 `enable_super_kernel` 时，Super Kernel 会跟随 static kernel "
+"并启用。显式设置 `enable_super_kernel` 可覆盖此继承行为。当 static kernel 禁用时，无法启用 Super "
+"Kernel。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Not every operator is eligible for Super Kernel fusion. An unsupported "
+"operator may split the fusion range, so the actual coverage and performance "
+"benefit depend on the model and operator sequence. Changing the Super Kernel"
+" setting also changes the static-kernel compilation configuration and may "
+"cause the static-kernel cache to be rebuilt."
+msgstr ""
+"并非每个算子都符合 Super Kernel 融合的条件。不支持的算子可能会拆分融合范围，因此实际覆盖范围和性能收益取决于模型和算子序列。更改 "
+"Super Kernel 设置也会改变 static-kernel 编译配置，并可能导致 static-kernel 缓存重建。"
+
+msgid "To use static kernel without Super Kernel:"
+msgstr "要在不使用 Super Kernel 的情况下使用 static kernel："
+
+msgid "#### Verifying Super Kernel is active"
+msgstr "#### 验证 Super Kernel 已生效"
+
+msgid ""
+"When Super Kernel optimization is applied during ACLGraph capture, vLLM "
+"Ascend emits:"
+msgstr "当在 ACLGraph 捕获期间应用 Super Kernel 优化时，vLLM Ascend 会输出："
+
+msgid ""
+"This message confirms that the optimization step was invoked. To verify the "
+"resulting fusion coverage and performance benefit, collect an **Ascend "
+"Profiling** trace and inspect `kernel_details.csv`. Compare the kernel/task "
+"entries and latency with Super Kernel disabled; the profiler also reports "
+"the launch core count for generated Super Kernels in the `Block Dim` field."
+msgstr ""
+"此消息确认优化步骤已被调用。要验证最终的融合覆盖范围和性能收益，请采集 **Ascend Profiling** trace 并检查 "
+"`kernel_details.csv`。将 kernel/任务条目和延迟与禁用 Super Kernel 时进行对比；profiler 还会在 "
+"`Block Dim` 字段中报告生成的 Super Kernel 的启动核数。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Since v0.28.0, batches are routed by **token count** instead of the batch "
+"attention state: any batch within the preallocated budget runs on the xlite "
+"runtime, whether prefill, decode, or mixed. Before v0.28.0, decode-only mode"
+" only handled batches whose attention state was decode — any batch with a "
+"prefill was routed back to ACLGraph — so small prefill/mixed batches could "
+"never take the xlite path."
+msgstr ""
+"从 v0.28.0 开始，批次按 **token 数量** 而非批次注意力状态进行路由：任何在预分配预算内的批次都会在 xlite 运行时上运行，无论是"
+" prefill、decode 还是混合批次。在 v0.28.0 之前，decode-only 模式仅处理注意力状态为 decode 的批次——任何包含"
+" prefill 的批次都会被路由回 ACLGraph——因此小型 prefill/混合批次永远无法走 xlite 路径。"

This buffer is independent of " +"`global_segment_size` in `mooncake.json` — increasing the segment does not " +"fix `BUFFER_OVERFLOW`." msgstr "" -"Store/PD流量分离需要**CANN >= 9.1.0**。此功能适用于A3和Ascend " -"950产品部署，其中PD传输流量可使用HCCS，而Mooncake " -"Store流量可使用ROCE，从而避免两类流量在同一物理链路上竞争。有关更多HIXL部署模式，请参见[Mooncake + " -"HIXL池化方案总览](https://gitcode.com/cann/hixl/wiki/Mooncake%20+%20HIXL%20%E6%B1%A0%E5%8C%96%E6%96%B9%E6%A1%88%E6%80%BB%E8%A7%88%EF%BC%88A2%20-%20A3%EF%BC%89.md)。" +"**根因分析：** 当 `enable_ssd_offload=true` 时，Mooncake 会为每个 rank 分配独立的 SSD " +"读写缓冲区。该缓冲区与 `mooncake.json` 中的 `global_segment_size` 无关——增大 segment 并不能解决 " +"`BUFFER_OVERFLOW`。" msgid "" -"Both the Mooncake and Memcache backends support configuring the transfer\n" -"QoS. +msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-09-23 09:46+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-09-23 09:46+0000\n"
+"Last-Translator: \n"
+"Language-Team: zh_CN <LL@li.org>\n"
+"Language: zh_CN\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n"
+"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n"
+
+msgid "# KVPP (Experimental)"
+msgstr "# KVPP（实验性）"
+
+msgid "## Overview"
+msgstr "## 概述"
+
+msgid ""
+"KVPP (KV pipeline parallelism) distributes historical KV caches that would "
+"otherwise be replicated across TP ranks by layer for non-hybrid MLA/SFA "
+"models. This reduces persistent cache storage per rank, allowing the same "
+"HBM capacity to accommodate more context tokens or concurrent requests."
+msgstr ""
+"KVPP（KV 流水线并行）针对非混合 MLA/SFA 模型，将原本会在 TP 各 rank 间复制的历史 KV 缓存按层进行分布。这减少了每个 "
+"rank 的持久化缓存存储占用，使相同的 HBM 容量能够容纳更多的上下文 token 或并发请求。"
+
+msgid ""
+"When a layer executes, the rank responsible for its cache broadcasts the "
+"complete cache to the other ranks in the group. Model computation retains "
+"its TP/EP/PP configuration. With PP enabled, each stage assigns caches and "
+"broadcasts within its own cache-replica group. The group spans TP ranks, or "
+"PCP × TP ranks when PCP is enabled on Model Runner V2, and never crosses DP "
+"replicas or PP stages."
+msgstr ""
+"当某一层执行时，负责该层缓存的 rank 会将完整缓存广播给组内的其他 rank。模型计算仍保持其 TP/EP/PP 配置。启用 PP 时，每个 "
+"stage 在各自的缓存副本组内分配并广播缓存。该组跨越 TP rank，或在 Model Runner V2 上启用 PCP 时跨越 PCP × TP"
+" rank，且绝不会跨越 DP 副本或 PP stage。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The pipeline parallelism in KVPP refers to KV cache storage and "
+"communication, while model computation keeps the parallel configuration "
+"described above. For the underlying layer-wise KV storage concept, see "
+"**LayerSplit** in Z.ai's [Scaling Pain of Coding Agent Serving: Lessons from"
+" Debugging GLM-5 at Scale](https://z.ai/blog/scaling-pain)."
+msgstr ""
+"KVPP 中的流水线并行指的是 KV 缓存的存储与通信，而模型计算仍保持上述并行配置。关于底层的按层 KV 存储概念，请参见 Z.ai 的 "
+"[Scaling Pain of Coding Agent Serving: Lessons from Debugging GLM-5 at "
+"Scale](https://z.ai/blog/scaling-pain) 中的 **LayerSplit**。"
+
+msgid "## Use Cases"
+msgstr "## 使用场景"
+
+msgid ""
+"KVPP targets long-context inference and concurrent serving workloads where "
+"duplicated KV caches limit the available cache capacity. It can also be "
+"combined with prefix caching and KV pooling for workloads with reusable long"
+" prefixes."
+msgstr ""
+"KVPP 面向长上下文推理和并发服务负载，这些场景中重复的 KV 缓存限制了可用的缓存容量。对于具有可复用长前缀的负载，它还可以与前缀缓存和 KV "
+"池化结合使用。"
+
+msgid ""
+"On 950DT Products, the measured KV cache capacity was **6.25×** with "
+"GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 on one eight-device node using TP8 + EP, and **5.35×** with "
+"GLM-5.2-W8A8C8-mxfp8 on two eight-device nodes using TP8 + PP2 + EP (38/40 "
+"layers). Each comparison uses the same model, hardware, and memory budget "
+"with KVPP off and on. These capacity ratios are specific to the "
+"configurations in the performance section; they are not throughput "
+"multipliers or guarantees for other models."
+msgstr ""
+"在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上，使用 TP8 + EP 在单台八卡节点上运行 GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 时，实测 KV 缓存容量为 "
+"**6.25×**；使用 TP8 + PP2 + EP（38/40 层）在两台八卡节点上运行 GLM-5.2-W8A8C8-mxfp8 时为 "
+"**5.35×**。每次对比均使用相同的模型、硬件和内存预算，分别在关闭和开启 KVPP "
+"的情况下进行。这些容量比仅适用于性能章节中的特定配置；它们不是吞吐量倍数，也不构成对其他模型的保证。"
+
+msgid "## Supported Scenarios"
+msgstr "## 支持的场景"
+
+msgid "### Supported Models"
+msgstr "### 支持的模型"
+
+msgid ""
+"KVPP supports non-hybrid MLA and SFA models with Model Runner V1 and V2. "
+"Combining KVPP with PCP requires Model Runner V2."
+msgstr ""
+"KVPP 在 Model Runner V1 和 V2 下支持非混合 MLA 和 SFA 模型。将 KVPP 与 PCP 结合使用需要 Model "
+"Runner V2。"
+
+msgid "| Attention backend | KVPP support | Model scope |"
+msgstr "| 注意力后端 | KVPP 支持 | 模型范围 |"
+
+msgid "| MLA | ✅ Supported | Non-hybrid models using MLA |"
+msgstr "| MLA | ✅ 支持 | 使用 MLA 的非混合模型 |"
+
+msgid "| SFA | ✅ Supported | Non-hybrid models using SFA, such as GLM-5.2 |"
+msgstr "| SFA | ✅ 支持 | 使用 SFA 的非混合模型，例如 GLM-5.2 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Models must also meet the hardware, quantization, and attention-backend "
+"requirements of vLLM Ascend."
+msgstr "模型还必须满足 vLLM Ascend 的硬件、量化以及注意力后端要求。"
+
+msgid "### Supported Features"
+msgstr "### 支持的特性"
+
+msgid ""
+"The following table lists individual feature combinations with KVPP. It does"
+" not imply that all listed features can be enabled together."
+msgstr "下表列出了与 KVPP 配合的各项特性组合。这并不意味着所有列出的特性都可以同时启用。"
+
+msgid "| Feature or combination | Support | Conditions and limitations |"
+msgstr "| 特性或组合 | 支持情况 | 条件与限制 |"
+
+msgid "| Eager mode | ✅ Supported | Use `--enforce-eager`. |"
+msgstr "| Eager 模式 | ✅ 支持 | 使用 `--enforce-eager`。 |"
+
+msgid "| Graph mode | ❌ Not supported | KVPP currently requires eager mode. |"
+msgstr "| 图模式 | ❌ 不支持 | KVPP 目前需要 eager 模式。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| TP | ✅ Supported | KV caches are assigned by layer within each cache-"
+"replica group. |"
+msgstr "| TP | ✅ 支持 | KV 缓存在每个缓存副本组内按层分配。 |"
+
+msgid "| EP | ✅ Supported | Requires an MoE model that supports EP. |"
+msgstr "| EP | ✅ 支持 | 需要支持 EP 的 MoE 模型。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| PP | ✅ Supported | Each PP stage allocates and broadcasts its caches "
+"independently. |"
+msgstr "| PP | ✅ 支持 | 每个 PP stage 独立分配并广播其缓存。 |"
+
+msgid "| Chunked prefill | ✅ Supported | Can be combined with KVPP. |"
+msgstr "| 分块预填充 | ✅ 支持 | 可与 KVPP 结合使用。 |"
+
+msgid "| Prefix caching | ✅ Supported | Can be combined with KVPP. |"
+msgstr "| 前缀缓存 | ✅ 支持 | 可与 KVPP 结合使用。 |"
+
+msgid "| Asynchronous scheduling | ✅ Supported | Can be combined with KVPP. |"
+msgstr "| 异步调度 | ✅ 支持 | 可与 KVPP 结合使用。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| LI-C8 and SFA-C8 cache layouts | ✅ Supported | Allocation follows the "
+"actual KV cache specifications. |"
+msgstr "| LI-C8 和 SFA-C8 缓存布局 | ✅ 支持 | 分配遵循实际的 KV 缓存规格。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Fixed-step MTP | ✅ Supported | MTP caches are allocated independently and "
+"excluded from KVPP layer partitioning. |"
+msgstr "| 固定步长 MTP | ✅ 支持 | MTP 缓存独立分配，不参与 KVPP 的层划分。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Variable-step MTP and other speculative decoding methods | ❌ Not supported"
+" | Only fixed-step MTP is supported. |"
+msgstr "| 可变步长 MTP 及其他投机解码方法 | ❌ 不支持 | 仅支持固定步长 MTP。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| PCP | ✅ Supported | Requires Model Runner V2; caches are shared across PCP"
+" × TP ranks. |"
+msgstr "| PCP | ✅ 支持 | 需要 Model Runner V2；缓存在 PCP × TP rank 间共享。 |"
+
+msgid "| DCP | ❌ Not supported | Cannot currently be combined with KVPP. |"
+msgstr "| DCP | ❌ 不支持 | 目前无法与 KVPP 结合使用。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| P/D disaggregation | ✅ Supported | Uses `MooncakeConnectorV2` "
+"(Experimental); enable KVPP only on the prefill node. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| P/D 分离 | ✅ 支持 | 使用 `MooncakeConnectorV2`（实验性）；仅在 prefill 节点上启用 KVPP。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| KV pooling | ✅ Supported | Memcache with `AscendStoreConnector`, "
+"`kv_producer` or `kv_both`, and asynchronous whole-block loading. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| KV 池化 | ✅ 支持 | 使用 `AscendStoreConnector` 的 Memcache、`kv_producer` 或 "
+"`kv_both`，以及异步整块加载。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| PCP + P/D disaggregation + KVPP | ❌ Not supported | `MooncakeConnectorV2` "
+"does not yet support PCP. |"
+msgstr "| PCP + P/D 分离 + KVPP | ❌ 不支持 | `MooncakeConnectorV2` 尚不支持 PCP。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| PCP + KV pooling + KVPP | ❌ Not supported | PCP and KV pooling are "
+"individually supported with KVPP, but the three-way combination is not "
+"supported. |"
+msgstr "| PCP + KV 池化 + KVPP | ❌ 不支持 | PCP 和 KV 池化均可单独与 KVPP 配合使用，但不支持三者组合。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"- ✅ **Supported**: The feature combination is supported under the stated conditions.\n"
+"- ❌ **Not supported**: The combination is not currently supported."
+msgstr ""
+"- ✅ **支持**：在所述条件下支持该特性组合。\n"
+"- ❌ **不支持**：目前不支持该组合。"
+
+msgid "## Usage"
+msgstr "## 使用方法"
+
+msgid ""
+"Enable KVPP through `enable_kvpp` in `--additional-config`, using eager "
+"mode:"
+msgstr "通过 `--additional-config` 中的 `enable_kvpp` 启用 KVPP，并使用 eager 模式："
+
+msgid ""
+"Replace `<model-path>` with a supported MLA/SFA model path and select TP "
+"according to model size and available devices. The KVPP group size follows "
+"TP × PCP and requires no separate setting. With PCP disabled, TP=1 provides "
+"no cache-sharing benefit across ranks."
+msgstr ""
+"将 `<model-path>` 替换为受支持的 MLA/SFA 模型路径，并根据模型大小和可用设备选择 TP。KVPP 组大小遵循 TP × "
+"PCP，无需单独设置。在禁用 PCP 的情况下，TP=1 不会带来跨 rank 的缓存共享收益。"
+
+msgid ""
+"If the launch command already contains `--additional-config`, merge "
+"`enable_kvpp` into the existing JSON object."
+msgstr "如果启动命令中已包含 `--additional-config`，请将 `enable_kvpp` 合并到现有的 JSON 对象中。"
+
+msgid "### Combining Features"
+msgstr "### 组合特性"
+
+msgid ""
+"KVPP can be combined with EP, PP, chunked prefill, prefix caching, and "
+"asynchronous scheduling. The following example uses an MoE model that "
+"supports EP:"
+msgstr "KVPP 可与 EP、PP、分块预填充、前缀缓存和异步调度结合使用。以下示例使用支持 EP 的 MoE 模型："
+
+msgid ""
+"Adjust the token budget and maximum number of sequences to device capacity "
+"and workload."
+msgstr "请根据设备容量和负载调整 token 预算和最大序列数。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For PCP, set `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` and add `--prefill-context-"
+"parallel-size` to the launch configuration. KVPP shares caches across PCP × "
+"TP ranks; Model Runner V1 does not support KVPP with PCP."
+msgstr ""
+"对于 PCP，请设置 `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`，并在启动配置中添加 `--prefill-context-"
+"parallel-size`。KVPP 在 PCP × TP rank 间共享缓存；Model Runner V1 不支持 KVPP 与 PCP "
+"结合使用。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For PP, add `enable_kvpp` to the existing PP launch configuration. Each "
+"stage allocates its caches independently. KVPP does not change PP layer "
+"partitioning."
+msgstr ""
+"对于 PP，在现有的 PP 启动配置中添加 `enable_kvpp`。每个 stage 独立分配其缓存。KVPP 不会改变 PP 的层划分。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Fixed-step MTP can be combined with KVPP, but MTP caches remain "
+"independently allocated and are excluded from KVPP layer partitioning. "
+"Follow the model-specific configuration requirements for MTP launch "
+"arguments."
+msgstr ""
+"固定步长 MTP 可以与 KVPP 结合使用，但 MTP 缓存仍独立分配，并被排除在 KVPP 层划分之外。请遵循模型特定的 MTP 启动参数配置要求。"
+
+msgid "## Configuration Parameters"
+msgstr "## 配置参数"
+
+msgid "| Parameter | Default | Description |"
+msgstr "| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `additional_config.enable_kvpp` | `false` | Enables KVPP; the group size "
+"follows TP × PCP. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `additional_config.enable_kvpp` | `false` | 启用 KVPP；组大小遵循 TP × PCP。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `--enforce-eager` | Not enabled | Required for KVPP; graph execution is "
+"not currently supported. |"
+msgstr "| `--enforce-eager` | 未启用 | KVPP 必需；当前不支持图执行。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"KVPP broadcasts each full layer once. No broadcast granularity or separate "
+"KVPP parallel size needs to be configured."
+msgstr "KVPP 对每个完整层广播一次。无需配置广播粒度或单独的 KVPP 并行大小。"
+
+msgid "## KV Transfer Configuration"
+msgstr "## KV 传输配置"
+
+msgid "### PD Disaggregation"
+msgstr "### PD 分离"
+
+msgid ""
+"KVPP supports P/D disaggregation through `MooncakeConnectorV2` "
+"(**Experimental**). The connector code has been merged but has not yet been "
+"released."
+msgstr "KVPP 通过 `MooncakeConnectorV2` 支持 P/D 分离（**实验性**）。该连接器代码已合入但尚未发布。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use `MooncakeConnectorV2` with `kv_producer` on the prefill node and "
+"`kv_consumer` on the decode node. Enable KVPP only on the prefill node. MTP "
+"caches remain replicated and are transferred alongside the persistent target"
+" caches."
+msgstr ""
+"在 prefill 节点上使用 `MooncakeConnectorV2` 并配置 `kv_producer`，在 decode 节点上配置 "
+"`kv_consumer`。仅在 prefill 节点上启用 KVPP。MTP 缓存保持副本，并与持久化目标缓存一同传输。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Each worker uses a handshake port derived from `kv_port` and its parallel "
+"rank. Choose non-overlapping port ranges when both nodes run on one host."
+msgstr "每个 worker 使用由 `kv_port` 及其并行 rank 派生的握手端口。当两个节点运行在同一主机上时，请选择不重叠的端口范围。"
+
+msgid "### Memcache Pooling"
+msgstr "### Memcache 池化"
+
+msgid ""
+"KVPP supports `kv_producer` and `kv_both` for Memcache pooling. "
+"`kv_consumer` has not been tested and is outside the validated support "
+"scope."
+msgstr ""
+"KVPP 支持 `kv_producer` 和 `kv_both` 用于 Memcache 池化。`kv_consumer` "
+"尚未经过测试，不在已验证的支持范围内。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Configure the memcache SDK and MetaService as described in [KV "
+"Pool](kv_pool.md), then add:"
+msgstr "按照 [KV Pool](kv_pool.md) 中所述配置 memcache SDK 和 MetaService，然后添加："
+
+msgid ""
+"The example uses `kv_producer`; you can also set `kv_role` to `kv_both`. "
+"Both roles save and load prefixes in this pooling configuration. Keep "
+"`use_layerwise=false`, `load_async=true`, and `discard_partial_chunks=true` "
+"(the default). Layerwise pooling, KV events, and consumer write-back are not"
+" supported with KVPP."
+msgstr ""
+"该示例使用 `kv_producer`；你也可以将 `kv_role` 设置为 `kv_both`。在此池化配置中，两种角色都会保存和加载前缀。请保持 "
+"`use_layerwise=false`、`load_async=true` 和 "
+"`discard_partial_chunks=true`（默认值）。KVPP 不支持分层池化、KV 事件和 consumer 回写。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Each TP rank saves one complete object per token block containing its "
+"persistent target layers and its own MTP caches. Scratch buffers are "
+"excluded. Loading restores those same persistent buffers; the existing KVPP "
+"broadcast supplies other ranks when a layer executes. Pool lookup requires "
+"every nonempty owner shard across all PP stages."
+msgstr ""
+"每个 TP rank 为每个 token block 保存一个完整对象，其中包含其持久化目标层及其自身的 MTP 缓存。Scratch "
+"缓冲区被排除在外。加载时会恢复这些相同的持久化缓冲区；当某一层执行时，现有的 KVPP 广播会为其他 rank 提供数据。池查找要求所有 PP "
+"stage 上的每个非空 owner 分片都存在。"
+
+msgid "## Performance"
+msgstr "## 性能"
+
+msgid ""
+"The following measurements of GLM-5.2 on 950DT Products show the impact on "
+"cache capacity, time to first token (TTFT), and prefill throughput. The "
+"single-node and dual-node deployments use different quantized weights; "
+"compare KVPP on and off within each deployment."
+msgstr ""
+"以下在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上对 GLM-5.2 的测量展示了其对缓存容量、首 token 时延（TTFT）和 prefill "
+"吞吐量的影响。单节点和双节点部署使用不同的量化权重；请在每种部署内比较 KVPP 开启和关闭的情况。"
+
+msgid "### Test Configuration"
+msgstr "### 测试配置"
+
+msgid "| Setting | Single node | Dual-node PP |"
+msgstr "| 设置 | 单节点 | 双节点 PP |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Hardware | One node with 8 950DT Products | Two nodes with 8 950DT "
+"Products per node |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 硬件 | 一个节点，配备 8 个 Ascend 950DT系列产品 | 两个节点，每个节点配备 8 个 Ascend 950DT系列产品 |"
+
+msgid "| Model | GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 | GLM-5.2-W8A8C8-mxfp8 |"
+msgstr "| 模型 | GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 | GLM-5.2-W8A8C8-mxfp8 |"
+
+msgid "| Parallelism | TP8 + EP | TP8 + PP2 + EP, 38/40 layer split |"
+msgstr "| 并行 | TP8 + EP | TP8 + PP2 + EP，38/40 层划分 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Common settings | DSA-CP, chunked prefill, prefix caching, asynchronous "
+"scheduling, LI-C8, Model Runner V1, eager mode | Same as single node |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 通用设置 | DSA-CP、chunked prefill、前缀缓存、异步调度、LI-C8、Model Runner V1、eager 模式 | "
+"与单节点相同 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Scheduling and memory | `max_num_batched_tokens=32768`, `max_num_seqs=12`,"
+" `gpu_memory_utilization=0.90` | Same as single node |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 调度与内存 | "
+"`max_num_batched_tokens=32768`、`max_num_seqs=12`、`gpu_memory_utilization=0.90`"
+" | 与单节点相同 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"MTP and SFA-C8 were not enabled. All measurements below use a 32K scheduling"
+" token budget."
+msgstr "未启用 MTP 和 SFA-C8。以下所有测量均使用 32K 调度 token 预算。"
+
+msgid "### KV Cache Capacity"
+msgstr "### KV 缓存容量"
+
+msgid ""
+"The service calculated capacity automatically without a block-count "
+"override. Single-node values come from the pooling test configuration; dual-"
+"node values come from non-pooling service startup logs."
+msgstr "服务自动计算容量，未覆盖 block 数量。单节点数值来自池化测试配置；双节点数值来自非池化服务启动日志。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Deployment | KVPP disabled (tokens) | KVPP enabled (tokens) | Capacity "
+"multiplier | Equivalent KV memory savings at the same token capacity |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 部署 | KVPP 关闭（tokens） | KVPP 开启（tokens） | 容量倍数 | 相同 token 容量下的等效 KV 内存节省 |"
+
+msgid "| Single node | 235,008 | 1,467,904 | 6.25× | 83.99% |"
+msgstr "| 单节点 | 235,008 | 1,467,904 | 6.25× | 83.99% |"
+
+msgid "| Dual-node PP | 555,392 | 2,972,416 | 5.35× | 81.32% |"
+msgstr "| 双节点 PP | 555,392 | 2,972,416 | 5.35× | 81.32% |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Equivalent KV memory savings are estimated from the capacity ratio and do "
+"not represent the same reduction in total HBM usage. Each rank still needs "
+"two scratch buffers and independent MTP caches, so capacity gains depend on "
+"layer count, TP size, PP partitioning, and per-layer cache sizes."
+msgstr ""
+"等效 KV 内存节省是根据容量比率估算的，并不代表总 HBM 使用量的同等减少。每个 rank 仍需要两个 scratch 缓冲区和独立的 MTP "
+"缓存，因此容量增益取决于层数、TP 大小、PP 划分以及每层缓存大小。"
+
+msgid "### Time to First Token"
+msgstr "### 首 token 时延"
+
+msgid ""
+"This test measures long-input, zero-prefix-hit, low-concurrency requests. "
+"The single-node deployment uses GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 with eight 950DT Products and"
+" TP8 + EP. The dual-node deployment uses GLM-5.2-W8A8C8-mxfp8 with eight "
+"950DT Products per node and TP8 + PP2 + EP (38/40 layers). Other service "
+"settings follow the test configuration above."
+msgstr ""
+"该测试测量长输入、零前缀命中、低并发的请求。单节点部署使用 GLM-5.2-W4A8C8，配备八个 Ascend 950DT系列产品，采用 TP8 + "
+"EP。双节点部署使用 GLM-5.2-W8A8C8-mxfp8，每个节点配备八个 Ascend 950DT系列产品，采用 TP8 + PP2 + "
+"EP（38/40 层）。其他服务设置遵循上述测试配置。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Input lengths are 32K, 64K, and 128K tokens. Prefix cache hit rate was 0%, "
+"with 1 output token. Each result is the mean TTFT of 4 requests at client "
+"concurrency 1. A positive change indicates increased latency."
+msgstr ""
+"输入长度为 32K、64K 和 128K tokens。前缀缓存命中率为 0%，输出 1 个 token。每个结果是客户端并发为 1 时 4 "
+"个请求的平均 TTFT。正值变化表示时延增加。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Deployment | Input length | KVPP disabled | KVPP enabled | TTFT change |"
+msgstr "| 部署 | 输入长度 | KVPP 关闭 | KVPP 开启 | TTFT 变化 |"
+
+msgid "| Single node | 32K | 2.623 s | 2.614 s | -0.33% |"
+msgstr "| 单节点 | 32K | 2.623 s | 2.614 s | -0.33% |"
+
+msgid "| Single node | 64K | 5.295 s | 5.375 s | +1.52% |"
+msgstr "| 单节点 | 64K | 5.295 s | 5.375 s | +1.52% |"
+
+msgid "| Single node | 128K | 10.901 s | 11.268 s | +3.36% |"
+msgstr "| 单节点 | 128K | 10.901 s | 11.268 s | +3.36% |"
+
+msgid "| Dual-node PP | 32K | 2.900 s | 2.905 s | +0.19% |"
+msgstr "| 双节点 PP | 32K | 2.900 s | 2.905 s | +0.19% |"
+
+msgid "| Dual-node PP | 64K | 4.503 s | 4.887 s | +8.53% |"
+msgstr "| 双节点 PP | 64K | 4.503 s | 4.887 s | +8.53% |"
+
+msgid "| Dual-node PP | 128K | 7.805 s | 8.665 s | +11.01% |"
+msgstr "| 双节点 PP | 128K | 7.805 s | 8.665 s | +11.01% |"
+
+msgid "### Non-Pooling Prefill Throughput"
+msgstr "### 非池化 Prefill 吞吐量"
+
+msgid ""
+"Each run contained 40 requests at client concurrency 12, with 128K input "
+"tokens and 1 output token per request. KV pooling was disabled in both "
+"configurations."
+msgstr ""
+"每次运行包含 40 个请求，客户端并发为 12，每个请求 128K 输入 tokens 和 1 个输出 token。两种配置中均禁用了 KV 池化。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Deployment | Prefix cache hit rate | KVPP disabled (input tokens/s) | KVPP"
+" enabled (input tokens/s) | Throughput change |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 部署 | 前缀缓存命中率 | KVPP 关闭（输入 tokens/s） | KVPP 开启（输入 tokens/s） | 吞吐量变化 |"
+
+msgid "| Single node | 0% | 12,492.4 | 12,205.7 | -2.30% |"
+msgstr "| 单节点 | 0% | 12,492.4 | 12,205.7 | -2.30% |"
+
+msgid "| Single node | 90% | 116,516.2 | 110,224.8 | -5.40% |"
+msgstr "| 单节点 | 90% | 116,516.2 | 110,224.8 | -5.40% |"
+
+msgid "| Dual-node PP | 0% | 21,395.2 | 18,742.3 | -12.40% |"
+msgstr "| 双节点 PP | 0% | 21,395.2 | 18,742.3 | -12.40% |"
+
+msgid "| Dual-node PP | 90% | 177,375.4 | 154,717.3 | -12.77% |"
+msgstr "| 双节点 PP | 90% | 177,375.4 | 154,717.3 | -12.77% |"
+
+msgid ""
+"The actual hit rate in all 90% scenarios was 89.9414%. Under these "
+"workloads, KVPP increased cache capacity while adding broadcast overhead; "
+"non-pooling throughput did not improve."
+msgstr ""
+"在所有 90% 场景下，实际命中率为 89.9414%。在这些负载下，KVPP 增加了缓存容量，同时也带来了广播开销；非池化吞吐量并未提升。"
+
+msgid "## Usage Recommendations"
+msgstr "## 使用建议"
+
+msgid ""
+"Evaluate KVPP first on workloads limited by KV cache capacity. Compare "
+"capacity, TTFT, and throughput with KVPP on and off using realistic input "
+"lengths, concurrency, and prefix distributions, then select a configuration "
+"that meets the service latency requirements."
+msgstr ""
+"对于受 KV 缓存容量限制的负载，应优先评估 KVPP。使用真实的输入长度、并发量和前缀分布，对比开启和关闭 KVPP 时的容量、TTFT "
+"和吞吐量，然后选择满足服务延迟要求的配置。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Broadcasts transfer all allocated logical blocks of a layer without "
+"filtering for active requests, so increasing cache capacity also increases "
+"broadcast volume. Prefetching can overlap part of the communication with "
+"computation, but the benefit remains workload-dependent. When cache capacity"
+" is already sufficient, use measured latency and throughput to decide "
+"whether to enable KVPP."
+msgstr ""
+"广播会传输某一层所有已分配的逻辑块，而不会针对活跃请求进行过滤，因此增加缓存容量也会增加广播量。预取可以将部分通信与计算重叠，但收益仍取决于具体负载。当缓存容量已经足够时，应根据实测的延迟和吞吐量来决定是否启用"
+" KVPP。"

+# SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE.

+# FIRST AUTHOR <EMAIL@ADDRESS>, 2026.

+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-09-23 09:46+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-09-23 09:46+0000\n"
+"Last-Translator: \n"
+"Language-Team: zh_CN <LL@li.org>\n"
+"Language: zh_CN\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n"
+"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n"
+
+msgid "# Mooncake Layerwise Hybrid Attention"
+msgstr "# Mooncake 分层混合注意力"
+
+msgid ""
+"This extension adds multi-KV-group support to the Mooncake layerwise range/session\n"
+"implementation introduced in [PR #16004](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16004).\n"
+"The implementation was based on upstream main at\n"
+"`be427041bf63a620e4a637b60f2656e87dcdf8f6`."
+msgstr ""
+"本扩展为 [PR #16004](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16004) 引入的 Mooncake 分层 range/session 实现增加了多 KV 组支持。\n"
+"该实现基于上游 main 分支的\n"
+"`be427041bf63a620e4a637b60f2656e87dcdf8f6`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"It targets attention layouts such as DeepSeek-V4, where sliding-window KV,\n"
+"compressed KV, indexer caches, and compressor state can belong to different KV\n"
+"groups. It reuses the shared reachability coordinator also used by Memcache;\n"
+"see the design discussion in [issue #12234](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12234).\n"
+"It does not translate Mooncake operations into Memcache GVA operations."
+msgstr ""
+"它面向 DeepSeek-V4 等注意力布局，其中滑动窗口 KV、\n"
+"压缩 KV、indexer 缓存和 compressor 状态可以属于不同的 KV\n"
+"组。它复用了 Memcache 也在使用的共享可达性协调器；\n"
+"参见 [issue #12234](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12234) 中的设计讨论。\n"
+"它不会将 Mooncake 操作转换为 Memcache GVA 操作。"
+
+msgid "## Scope and prerequisites"
+msgstr "## 适用范围与前提条件"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Use `AscendStoreConnector` with `backend=\"mooncake\"` and `use_layerwise=true`.\n"
+"- Install a Mooncake client with the range/session interfaces listed in the\n"
+"  [single-group guide](mooncake_layerwise_adaptation_and_optimization.md#51-mooncake-version).\n"
+"- The model must provide valid `KVCacheConfig.kv_cache_groups` and group block\n"
+"  tables. Runtime group block sizes already describe raw-token coverage; do not\n"
+"  multiply them by the compression ratio again.\n"
+"- This patch wires compute windows into the Ascend DSA, FA, and SFA attention\n"
+"  paths. Start validation in eager mode. Graph-mode execution and additional\n"
+"  attention backends require separate integration validation.\n"
+"- Topology-matched PP supports uneven partitions and stage-local hybrid groups.\n"
+"  DCP, PCP and prefill/decode TP mismatch remain unsupported.\n"
+"- Recurrent Mamba state is explicitly rejected. Hybrid attention and hybrid\n"
+"  recurrent/linear-attention state are not interchangeable.\n"
+"- Only complete, coordinator-aligned block snapshots are published. Partial\n"
+"  block offloading and cross-layer cache-buffer reuse are not part of this\n"
+"  hybrid implementation."
+msgstr ""
+"- 使用 `AscendStoreConnector`，并设置 `backend=\"mooncake\"` 和 `use_layerwise=true`。\n"
+"- 安装带有 range/session 接口的 Mooncake 客户端，接口列表见\n"
+"  [单组指南](mooncake_layerwise_adaptation_and_optimization.md#51-mooncake-version)。\n"
+"- 模型必须提供有效的 `KVCacheConfig.kv_cache_groups` 和组块\n"
+"  表。运行时组块大小已经描述了原始 token 覆盖范围；不要\n"
+"  再将其乘以压缩比。\n"
+"- 本补丁将计算窗口接入昇腾 DSA、FA 和 SFA 注意力\n"
+"  路径。请在 eager 模式下开始验证。图模式执行和其他\n"
+"  注意力后端需要单独的集成验证。\n"
+"- 拓扑匹配的 PP 支持不均匀分区和阶段本地混合组。\n"
+"  DCP、PCP 以及 prefill/decode TP 不匹配仍不受支持。\n"
+"- 循环 Mamba 状态被明确拒绝。混合注意力和混合\n"
+"  循环/线性注意力状态不可互换。\n"
+"- 仅发布完整的、与协调器对齐的块快照。部分\n"
+"  块卸载和跨层缓存缓冲区复用不属于本\n"
+"  混合实现。"
+
+msgid "## Group-aware objects and range offsets"
+msgstr "## 组感知对象与 range 偏移"
+
+msgid ""
+"The single-group wire format is unchanged. Hybrid layouts use a separate\n"
+"namespace:"
+msgstr ""
+"单组线格式保持不变。混合布局使用单独的\n"
+"命名空间："
+
+msgid ""
+"The digest includes TP size, ordered group membership, and each group's page-size\n"
+"signature. Together with the group ID, it identifies the cache group without\n"
+"duplicating the scheduler's cache-family classification in the object key. It\n"
+"prevents incompatible group layouts from reading the same objects. It is not a\n"
+"model-weight checksum or a tenant isolation mechanism: use isolated deployments\n"
+"for different weights with identical model names and cache specifications."
+msgstr ""
+"该摘要包含 TP 大小、有序组成员关系以及每个组的页大小\n"
+"签名。它与组 ID 一起标识缓存组，而无需\n"
+"在对象键中重复调度器的缓存族分类。它\n"
+"可防止不兼容的组布局读取相同的对象。它并非\n"
+"模型权重校验和或租户隔离机制：对于模型名称和缓存规格相同\n"
+"但权重不同的情况，请使用隔离部署。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Each key stores one block for one group and storing head/rank. Its bytes contain\n"
+"only that group's registered cache entries, ordered by physical layer and cache\n"
+"name. Object size is the sum of their actual per-block byte lengths. A transfer\n"
+"uses the group-local layer index to calculate remote offsets, while the physical\n"
+"layer index selects the compute event and completion signal."
+msgstr ""
+"每个键为单个组和存储 head/rank 存储一个块。其字节仅包含\n"
+"该组注册的缓存条目，按物理层和缓存\n"
+"名称排序。对象大小是它们实际每块字节长度的总和。传输\n"
+"使用组本地层索引来计算远程偏移，而物理\n"
+"层索引用于选择计算事件和完成信号。"
+
+msgid "For example:"
+msgstr "例如："
+
+msgid "| Group | Raw tokens/block | Physical layers | Commit boundary |"
+msgstr "| 组 | 原始 token/块 | 物理层 | 提交边界 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Several groups can transfer at one physical layer. A group is committed after\n"
+"its own last layer, not necessarily the model's last layer. Multiple cache\n"
+"entries at the same physical layer remain separate byte ranges."
+msgstr ""
+"多个组可以在同一物理层传输。一个组在其自身的\n"
+"最后一层之后提交，而不一定是模型的最后一层。同一物理层上的多个缓存\n"
+"条目仍保持为独立的字节范围。"
+
+msgid "## Reachability and session lifetime"
+msgstr "## 可达性与会话生命周期"
+
+msgid ""
+"The scheduler queries `batch_is_readable` for the keys selected by the coordinator's\n"
+"per-group lookup masks. A block is usable only if all required stage and storing-head keys\n"
+"are committed and readable. The coordinator then determines a common reachable token boundary across\n"
+"groups. A full-attention hit alone is insufficient when the corresponding\n"
+"window or compressor state is missing."
+msgstr ""
+"调度器针对协调器按组查找掩码选中的键查询 `batch_is_readable`。\n"
+"仅当所有必需的阶段和存储 head 键均已提交且可读时，块才可用。\n"
+"随后协调器确定跨组的公共可达 token 边界。\n"
+"当对应的窗口或 compressor 状态缺失时，仅命中全注意力\n"
+"是不够的。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The worker uses the same coordinator for store and load masks. It does not\n"
+"interpret a sparse state cache as a contiguous prefix. A mask-generation failure\n"
+"is not silently converted into a request to copy every state block."
+msgstr ""
+"worker 对存储和加载掩码使用相同的协调器。它不会\n"
+"将稀疏状态缓存解释为连续前缀。掩码生成失败\n"
+"不会被静默转换为复制每个状态块的请求。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The worker creates separate request views for each group. Session ownership is\n"
+"indexed by `(request_id, group_id, logical_block_index)`, so block zero in one\n"
+"group cannot replace block zero in another. Across chunked-prefill steps, committed\n"
+"keys can be restored using the current local block IDs even without a new\n"
+"scheduler load specification. Each group retains independent active-transfer\n"
+"state and resets it at its last group layer."
+msgstr ""
+"worker 为每个组创建单独的请求视图。会话所有权\n"
+"以 `(request_id, group_id, logical_block_index)` 为索引，因此一个组中的块零\n"
+"无法替换另一个组中的块零。在分块预填充步骤之间，即使没有新的\n"
+"调度器加载规格，也可以使用当前本地块 ID 恢复已提交的\n"
+"键。每个组保留独立的活跃传输\n"
+"状态，并在其最后一个组层重置。"
+
+msgid ""
+"A failed range put revokes the affected keys; successful keys in other groups\n"
+"can still commit. A preparation exception revokes the objects opened earlier in\n"
+"that preparation. A failed get stops the forward path before incomplete hybrid\n"
+"KV/state is used. Get sessions are released after in-flight reads finish."
+msgstr ""
+"失败的 range put 会撤销受影响的键；其他组中成功的键\n"
+"仍可提交。准备过程中的异常会撤销该准备过程中\n"
+"先前打开的对象。失败的 get 会在使用不完整的混合\n"
+"KV/状态之前停止前向路径。Get 会话在飞行中的读取完成后释放。"
+
+msgid "## Transfer timing: configurable asynchronous pipeline"
+msgstr "## 传输时序：可配置的异步流水线"
+
+msgid "The heavy payload operations use a per-layer attention compute window:"
+msgstr "重负载操作使用每层注意力计算窗口："
+
+msgid ""
+"At attention entry, an NPU event protects cache writes and preceding work on the\n"
+"compute stream. Prefetched gets wait for that event. The worker records the save\n"
+"event and submits current-layer puts at the same boundary. The host then launches\n"
+"the attention kernel and applies the configured queue policy before returning\n"
+"to the following output projection or MoE communication."
+msgstr ""
+"在注意力入口处，一个 NPU 事件保护计算流上的缓存写入和\n"
+"先前工作。预取的 get 等待该事件。worker 记录保存\n"
+"事件并在同一边界提交当前层的 put。随后主机启动\n"
+"注意力内核，并在返回\n"
+"后续输出投影或 MoE 通信之前应用配置的队列策略。"
+
+msgid ""
+"By default, future-layer gets remain queued and up to eight send tasks may stay\n"
+"unfinished. This removes whole-queue drains from each layer's critical path,\n"
+"but it also means transfer can overlap subsequent output-projection or MoE\n"
+"communication. This is an internal scheduling policy rather than a public\n"
+"runtime setting. Error and teardown paths still drain both queues completely."
+msgstr ""
+"默认情况下，未来层的 get 保持排队，最多八个发送任务可能保持\n"
+"未完成。这从每层的关键路径中移除了整队列排空，\n"
+"但这也意味着传输可以与后续的输出投影或 MoE\n"
+"通信重叠。这是内部调度策略，而非公开的\n"
+"运行时设置。错误和拆除路径仍会完全排空两个队列。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In DSA this boundary is after the compressor/indexer/cache updates and before\n"
+"the sparse-attention operator. In SFA it surrounds the sparse-attention operator;\n"
+"in FA it surrounds the paged/FIA attention path. It does not surround the whole\n"
+"transformer layer."
+msgstr ""
+"在 DSA 中，该边界位于 compressor/indexer/cache 更新之后、稀疏注意力算子之前。在 SFA 中，它包围稀疏注意力算子；在 "
+"FA 中，它包围分页/FIA 注意力路径。它并不包围整个 transformer 层。"
+
+msgid "Consequences:"
+msgstr "影响："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Under the default policy, a transfer tail can compete with subsequent HCCL or\n"
+"  expert-parallel communication. Device traces should be used to validate this\n"
+"  fixed policy on the target deployment.\n"
+"- An initial, unprefetched demand load has no preceding attention window. It\n"
+"  waits for earlier compute-stream work, then completes before attention starts.\n"
+"- Session allocation, existence queries, and other metadata RPCs are not payload\n"
+"  DMA and can occur outside the window.\n"
+"- This is a local queue policy, not a cluster-wide bandwidth scheduler.\n"
+"  Unrelated workers and independent communication streams are not globally\n"
+"  serialized. Validate multistream and multi-rank behavior using device traces.\n"
+"- No latency or throughput improvement is claimed without hardware measurements.\n"
+"  Short attention kernels can expose a substantial transfer tail."
+msgstr ""
+"- 在默认策略下，传输尾部可能与后续的 HCCL 或专家并行通信产生竞争。应使用设备 trace 在目标部署上验证这一固定策略。\n"
+"- 初始的、未预取的按需加载没有前置的注意力窗口。它会等待更早的计算流工作，然后在注意力开始前完成。\n"
+"- 会话分配、存在性查询以及其他元数据 RPC 不属于 payload DMA，可以发生在窗口之外。\n"
+"- 这是一种本地队列策略，而非集群范围的带宽调度器。不相关的工作进程和独立的通信流不会被全局串行化。应使用设备 trace 验证多流和多 rank 行为。\n"
+"- 在没有硬件测量的情况下，不声称任何延迟或吞吐量改进。较短的注意力 kernel 可能暴露出显著的传输尾部。"
+
+msgid "## Configuration"
+msgstr "## 配置"
+
+msgid ""
+"Choose TP size, chunk size, quantization, and model arguments for the actual\n"
+"hardware/model. Begin with two future-layer prefetch windows. This example is\n"
+"not a verified DeepSeek-V4 deployment recipe or a memory-capacity guarantee."
+msgstr ""
+"根据实际硬件/模型选择 TP 大小、chunk 大小、量化方式和模型参数。从两个未来层预取窗口开始。本示例并非经过验证的 DeepSeek-V4 "
+"部署方案，也不构成内存容量保证。"
+
+msgid "## Validation"
+msgstr "## 验证"
+
+msgid ""
+"CPU/mock unit tests cover group-aware byte round trips, different block sizes,\n"
+"unequal cache-entry counts, sparse masks, independent commit boundaries, group\n"
+"session ownership, continuation with remapped local blocks, negative transfer\n"
+"results, allocation rollback, device-event gating, and fatal-thread propagation.\n"
+"They do not execute attention kernels or a real Mooncake service."
+msgstr ""
+"CPU/mock 单元测试覆盖了组感知的字节往返、不同的 block 大小、不相等的 cache "
+"条目数量、稀疏掩码、独立的提交边界、组会话归属、使用重映射本地 block "
+"的续传、传输失败结果、分配回滚、设备事件门控以及致命线程传播。它们不会执行注意力 kernel 或真实的 Mooncake 服务。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Real NPU and distributed Mooncake validation is still required and is not\n"
+"automated by this change. Use the project-approved deployment and benchmark\n"
+"workflow for the target model and hardware. Compare layerwise and non-layerwise\n"
+"Mooncake with otherwise identical settings and isolated test pools, and run\n"
+"performance measurements without profiling or range-debug logging enabled."
+msgstr ""
+"仍然需要真实的 NPU 和分布式 Mooncake "
+"验证，本次变更并未将其自动化。请使用项目批准的部署和基准测试流程，针对目标模型和硬件进行验证。在其余设置完全相同且测试池隔离的情况下，对比分层和非分层 "
+"Mooncake，并在不启用 profiling 或 range-debug 日志的情况下运行性能测量。"
+
+msgid "Before claiming hardware support or a performance improvement, verify:"
+msgstr "在声称支持硬件或性能改进之前，请验证："
+
+msgid ""
+"1. Cold/warm token equality, positive remote hits, and multiple chunk boundaries\n"
+"   on the real hybrid model.\n"
+"2. Every group, including sparse state and indexer groups, has valid load ranges.\n"
+"   Check Mooncake range-debug logs alongside the device trace.\n"
+"3. Put/get payload ranges begin after cache-ready events and complete before\n"
+"   subsequent HCCL on the tested device; inspect all relevant streams and ranks.\n"
+"4. TTFT, throughput, exposed transfer tails, and HCCL duration against the\n"
+"   non-layerwise baseline under the same model, TP, prompt, and pool conditions.\n"
+"5. Additional concurrent-request, preemption, model-specific state, and service\n"
+"   failure tests. The smoke script alone does not establish production readiness."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 在真实混合模型上验证冷/热 token 一致性、正向远程命中以及多个 chunk 边界。\n"
+"2. 每个组（包括稀疏状态组和 indexer 组）都具有有效的加载范围。结合设备 trace 检查 Mooncake range-debug 日志。\n"
+"3. 在受测设备上，put/get payload 范围在 cache-ready 事件之后开始，并在后续 HCCL 之前完成；检查所有相关的流和 rank。\n"
+"4. 在相同模型、TP、prompt 和池条件下，对比非分层基线的 TTFT、吞吐量、暴露的传输尾部以及 HCCL 持续时间。\n"
+"5. 额外的并发请求、抢占、模型特定状态以及服务故障测试。仅凭冒烟脚本无法确立生产就绪性。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Real NPU/Mooncake validation is pending; the implementation environment only\n"
+"supports CPU/mock checks."
+msgstr "真实的 NPU/Mooncake 验证尚待进行；当前实现环境仅支持 CPU/mock 检查。"

@@ -0,0 +1,478 @@
+# SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE.
+# Copyright (C) 2026, vllm-ascend team
+# This file is distributed under the same license as the vllm-ascend package.
+# FIRST AUTHOR <EMAIL@ADDRESS>, 2026.
+#
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-09-23 09:46+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-09-23 09:46+0000\n"
+"Last-Translator: \n"
+"Language-Team: zh_CN <LL@li.org>\n"
+"Language: zh_CN\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n"
+"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n"
+
+msgid "# Mooncake Layerwise Adaptation and Optimization Analysis"
+msgstr "# Mooncake 分层适配与优化分析"
+
+msgid ""
+"For the subsequent multi-group attention extension and its validation boundaries,\n"
+"see [Mooncake Layerwise Hybrid Attention](mooncake_hybrid_attention.md)."
+msgstr ""
+"关于后续的多组注意力扩展及其验证边界，\n"
+"请参阅 [Mooncake 分层混合注意力](mooncake_hybrid_attention.md)。"
+
+msgid "## 1. Adaptation Baseline and Conclusion"
+msgstr "## 1. 适配基线与结论"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Baseline: `Eric-dot/vllm-ascend:mooncake` at local commit `0a023b094e9e88ffaca0b1fda02529cef6277f8e`.\n"
+"- Reference implementation: `vllm-project/vllm-ascend#12418`.\n"
+"- Local working branch: `eric-mooncake-pr12418-port`.\n"
+"- Current status: The core implementation, CPU mock unit tests, and static checks have passed. End-to-end testing\n"
+"  on real Ascend NPUs, Mooncake Master/Metadata services, and multiple TP processes has not yet been completed."
+msgstr ""
+"- 基线：`Eric-dot/vllm-ascend:mooncake`，本地提交 `0a023b094e9e88ffaca0b1fda02529cef6277f8e`。\n"
+"- 参考实现：`vllm-project/vllm-ascend#12418`。\n"
+"- 本地工作分支：`eric-mooncake-pr12418-port`。\n"
+"- 当前状态：核心实现、CPU mock 单元测试和静态检查均已通过。在真实昇腾 NPU、Mooncake Master/Metadata 服务以及多 TP 进程上的端到端测试尚未完成。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This adaptation does not directly copy the earlier PR. The personal branch already contains an updated\n"
+"`metadata.py`, multi-cache-entry/MTP/SFA layouts, Memcache GVA layerwise transfer, asynchronous thread exception\n"
+"propagation, and layer-buffer reuse. The Mooncake path therefore reuses these newer structures and adds an\n"
+"independent key-major range/session protocol."
+msgstr ""
+"本次适配并未直接复制早前的 PR。个人分支已包含更新后的\n"
+"`metadata.py`、多缓存条目/MTP/SFA 布局、Memcache GVA 分层传输、异步线程异常\n"
+"传播以及层缓冲区复用。因此 Mooncake 路径复用了这些较新的结构，并新增了\n"
+"独立的以 key 为主的 range/session 协议。"
+
+msgid ""
+"## 2. Why the Remote Object Count Drops from `block × layer × rank` to "
+"`block × rank`"
+msgstr "## 2. 为什么远端对象数量从 `block × layer × rank` 降至 `block × rank`"
+
+msgid ""
+"The earlier per-layer key scheme treats each layer as a separate remote "
+"object:"
+msgstr "早前的逐层 key 方案将每一层视为独立的远端对象："
+
+msgid ""
+"For `B` blocks, `L` layers, and `R` ranks that actually store data, the "
+"approximate object count is:"
+msgstr "对于 `B` 个 block、`L` 层以及实际存储数据的 `R` 个 rank，对象数量约为："
+
+msgid ""
+"Mooncake layerwise transfer creates only one object for each block/rank "
+"pair:"
+msgstr "Mooncake 分层传输为每个 block/rank 对仅创建一个对象："
+
+msgid ""
+"All layers are placed contiguously inside the object according to the actual"
+" cache layout:"
+msgstr "所有层按照实际缓存布局连续放置在对象内部："
+
+msgid ""
+"After each layer finishes computing, only the byte range for that layer is written to the same object. Layerwise\n"
+"transfer changes the transfer timing and ranges; it does not require every layer to be a separate object. The object\n"
+"count therefore becomes:"
+msgstr ""
+"每一层计算完成后，仅将该层的字节范围写入同一对象。分层\n"
+"传输改变了传输时机和范围；它并不要求每一层都是独立对象。因此对象\n"
+"数量变为："
+
+msgid ""
+"This reduces the number of Mooncake metadata objects, keys, sessions, and `exists` query items, but not the total KV\n"
+"payload size. KV data for every layer must still be stored."
+msgstr ""
+"这减少了 Mooncake 元数据对象、key、session 以及 `exists` 查询项的数量，但并未减少 KV\n"
+"负载的总大小。每一层的 KV 数据仍必须存储。"
+
+msgid "## 3. Data and Control Flow in the Current Implementation"
+msgstr "## 3. 当前实现中的数据流与控制流"
+
+msgid "### 3.1 Saving"
+msgstr "### 3.1 保存"
+
+msgid ""
+"1. The scheduler calls `batch_is_exist` with all storing-rank keys for each block.\n"
+"2. For missing keys, the worker calls `batch_put_session_start(keys, object_sizes, ReplicateConfig)`.\n"
+"3. `LayerBatchBuilder` calculates the following values from the actual cache-entry layout:\n"
+"   - The local NPU buffer address.\n"
+"   - The size of each cache entry in the layer.\n"
+"   - The destination offset of the layer within the remote all-layer object.\n"
+"4. After each attention layer finishes, the sending thread calls `batch_put_from_multi_buffer_ranges`.\n"
+"5. If a range write fails for one key, only that key is revoked; the remaining keys continue with subsequent layers.\n"
+"6. After the last layer succeeds, the worker calls `batch_put_session_end`. It calls `batch_put_session_revoke` for\n"
+"   keys that fail to commit.\n"
+"7. Only successfully committed keys enter the readable set for subsequent chunked-prefill steps."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 调度器针对每个 block，使用所有存储 rank 的 key 调用 `batch_is_exist`。\n"
+"2. 对于缺失的 key，worker 调用 `batch_put_session_start(keys, object_sizes, ReplicateConfig)`。\n"
+"3. `LayerBatchBuilder` 根据实际缓存条目布局计算以下值：\n"
+"   - 本地 NPU 缓冲区地址。\n"
+"   - 该层中每个缓存条目的大小。\n"
+"   - 该层在远端全层对象中的目标偏移量。\n"
+"4. 每个注意力层完成后，发送线程调用 `batch_put_from_multi_buffer_ranges`。\n"
+"5. 如果某个 key 的范围写入失败，仅撤销该 key；其余 key 继续处理后续层。\n"
+"6. 最后一层成功后，worker 调用 `batch_put_session_end`。对于提交失败的\n"
+"   key，它会调用 `batch_put_session_revoke`。\n"
+"7. 只有成功提交的 key 才会进入可读集合，供后续 chunked-prefill 步骤使用。"
+
+msgid "### 3.2 Loading"
+msgstr "### 3.2 加载"
+
+msgid ""
+"1. The scheduler counts only the contiguous prefix starting at block 0 for which every storing rank is `COMPLETE` as\n"
+"   a cache hit.\n"
+"2. The worker calls `batch_get_session_start` for the deduplicated remote keys.\n"
+"3. Before each layer computes, the receiving thread calls `batch_get_into_multi_buffer_ranges` to load that layer's\n"
+"   range into the local block.\n"
+"4. A failure in one row records the corresponding local block ID and returns it to the scheduler for recomputation,\n"
+"   preventing incomplete KV data from being consumed.\n"
+"5. The worker calls `batch_get_session_end` after the last layer or when the request terminates. Exceptional paths\n"
+"   release owners according to retry or terminal semantics."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 调度器仅将从 block 0 开始、且每个存储 rank 均为 `COMPLETE` 的连续前缀计为\n"
+"   缓存命中。\n"
+"2. worker 对去重后的远端 key 调用 `batch_get_session_start`。\n"
+"3. 每一层计算前，接收线程调用 `batch_get_into_multi_buffer_ranges` 将该层的\n"
+"   范围加载到本地 block。\n"
+"4. 某一行失败时会记录对应的本地 block ID 并将其返回给调度器以重新计算，\n"
+"   从而防止消费不完整的 KV 数据。\n"
+"5. worker 在最后一层之后或请求终止时调用 `batch_get_session_end`。异常路径\n"
+"   根据重试或终止语义释放 owner。"
+
+msgid "### 3.3 Chunked Prefill"
+msgstr "### 3.3 Chunked Prefill"
+
+msgid "`MooncakeSessionTracker` maintains three types of relationships:"
+msgstr "`MooncakeSessionTracker` 维护三种关系："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Put keys that have not yet been committed and their request/block owners.\n"
+"- Committed keys that later chunks of the same request can load.\n"
+"- Open get-session keys and their request owners."
+msgstr ""
+"- 尚未提交的 put key 及其 request/block owner。\n"
+"- 同一请求的后续 chunk 可以加载的已提交 key。\n"
+"- 打开的 get-session key 及其 request owner。"
+
+msgid "It guarantees that:"
+msgstr "它保证："
+
+msgid ""
+"- An object is not considered readable before it is committed.\n"
+"- A later chunk renews the lease and restores the previously committed prefix layer by layer, even when it has no new\n"
+"  `load_spec`.\n"
+"- A retry releases the get session while retaining the key/block relationships required for a subsequent retry.\n"
+"- A terminal or preempt event clears request state.\n"
+"- When multiple requests share the same remote key, get-end is executed only after the last owner releases it."
+msgstr ""
+"- 对象在提交之前不会被视为可读。\n"
+"- 后续 chunk 会续租并逐层恢复先前已提交的前缀，即使它没有新的\n"
+"  `load_spec`。\n"
+"- 重试会释放 get session，同时保留后续重试所需的 key/block 关系。\n"
+"- 终止或抢占事件会清除请求状态。\n"
+"- 当多个请求共享同一远端 key 时，仅当最后一个 owner 释放后才会执行 get-end。"
+
+msgid "## 4. Adaptations and Corrections Relative to the Original PR"
+msgstr "## 4. 相对于原始 PR 的适配与修正"
+
+msgid ""
+"### 4.1 Actual Layout Offsets Instead of a Fixed `layer_id × page_size`"
+msgstr "### 4.1 使用实际布局偏移量而非固定的 `layer_id × page_size`"
+
+msgid ""
+"The current branch supports multiple cache entries in one physical layer as well as MTP/SFA layouts. Remote offsets\n"
+"are calculated from `group_layer_cache_entry_offsets` and prefix sums of the actual `block_len` values:"
+msgstr ""
+"当前分支支持一个物理层中的多个缓存条目以及 MTP/SFA 布局。远端偏移量\n"
+"根据 `group_layer_cache_entry_offsets` 以及实际 `block_len` 值的前缀和计算："
+
+msgid ""
+"The remote object size therefore equals the total number of bytes across all cache entries for all layers on the\n"
+"current rank. The implementation no longer assumes that every layer has the same size or incorrectly multiplies the\n"
+"size by `num_layers` again."
+msgstr ""
+"因此，远端对象大小等于当前 rank 上所有层的所有缓存条目的总字节数。\n"
+"该实现不再假设每一层具有相同大小，也不再错误地将大小\n"
+"再次乘以 `num_layers`。"
+
+msgid "### 4.2 PutStart Inherits the Mooncake Placement Policy"
+msgstr "### 4.2 PutStart 继承 Mooncake 放置策略"
+
+msgid ""
+"The session-start path in the original PR did not pass `ReplicateConfig`. The current implementation matches the\n"
+"whole-key put path and passes:"
+msgstr ""
+"原始 PR 中的 session-start 路径未传递 `ReplicateConfig`。当前实现与\n"
+"整 key put 路径保持一致，并传递："
+
+msgid ""
+"- `preferred_segment`.\n"
+"- `prefer_alloc_in_same_node`."
+msgstr ""
+"- `preferred_segment`。\n"
+"- `prefer_alloc_in_same_node`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This prevents layerwise transfer from bypassing the existing local-first and"
+" same-node placement policies."
+msgstr "这防止分层传输绕过现有的本地优先和同节点放置策略。"
+
+msgid "### 4.3 Transfer Throttling for Range Calls"
+msgstr "### 4.3 针对 Range 调用的传输限流"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `layerwise_max_transfer_blocks` limits the number of key/block rows in a single range API call.\n"
+"- `layerwise_max_transfer_bytes` splits an oversized contiguous segment into smaller ranges."
+msgstr ""
+"- `layerwise_max_transfer_blocks` 限制单次 range API 调用中的 key/block 行数。\n"
+"- `layerwise_max_transfer_bytes` 将过大的连续段拆分为更小的 range。"
+
+msgid ""
+"PutStart, GetStart, GetEnd, and scheduler `exists` queries are also batched according to the block limit. This avoids\n"
+"oversized Python/C++ argument lists and transient metadata spikes for long prompts."
+msgstr ""
+"PutStart、GetStart、GetEnd 以及调度器的 `exists` 查询也会根据 block 限制进行批处理。这可以避免\n"
+"Python/C++ 参数列表过大，以及长 prompt 场景下元数据的瞬时峰值。"
+
+msgid "### 4.4 Fail Fast During Startup"
+msgstr "### 4.4 启动期间快速失败"
+
+msgid ""
+"Mooncake layerwise transfer checks all required session and range methods during startup. If an interface is missing,\n"
+"startup fails immediately and reports that the client must include Mooncake PR #2881, instead of failing in an\n"
+"asynchronous thread on the first request."
+msgstr ""
+"Mooncake layerwise 传输会在启动期间检查所有必需的 session 和 range 方法。如果缺少某个接口，\n"
+"启动会立即失败并提示客户端必须包含 Mooncake PR #2881，而不是在首次请求时于\n"
+"异步线程中失败。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The initial single-group implementation used only model, block hash and TP/head rank.\n"
+"Hybrid attention and topology-matched PP are covered by the\n"
+"[hybrid guide](mooncake_hybrid_attention.md).\n"
+"The implementation still explicitly rejects:"
+msgstr ""
+"最初的单组实现仅使用 model、block hash 和 TP/head rank。\n"
+"混合注意力与拓扑匹配的 PP 请参见\n"
+"[混合指南](mooncake_hybrid_attention.md)。\n"
+"该实现仍然明确拒绝："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Prefill or decode context parallel size greater than 1.\n"
+"- Recurrent Mamba state in hybrid layerwise mode, and PP stages with empty projected cache groups.\n"
+"- TP mismatch with layerwise transfer."
+msgstr ""
+"- Prefill 或 decode 的 context parallel size 大于 1。\n"
+"- 混合 layerwise 模式下的 Recurrent Mamba 状态，以及投影缓存组为空的 PP stage。\n"
+"- TP 与 layerwise 传输不匹配。"
+
+msgid "### 4.5 Exceptions and Fallbacks"
+msgstr "### 4.5 异常与回退"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Batch results must align one-to-one with keys. Missing items, Boolean values, and non-integer results are rejected.\n"
+"- A range exception publishes invalid-block and abort state before waking the compute thread.\n"
+"- A put exception revokes `PROCESSING` objects.\n"
+"- A get exception ends the session only after the range call is confirmed to have exited.\n"
+"- A consumer-only worker advances the layer cursor in the load hook instead of depending on a save hook that will\n"
+"  never be called."
+msgstr ""
+"- 批处理结果必须与 key 一一对应。缺失项、布尔值以及非整数结果都会被拒绝。\n"
+"- range 异常会在唤醒计算线程之前发布 invalid-block 和 abort 状态。\n"
+"- put 异常会撤销 `PROCESSING` 对象。\n"
+"- get 异常只有在确认 range 调用已退出后才会结束 session。\n"
+"- 仅作为 consumer 的 worker 会在 load hook 中推进 layer 游标，而不是依赖一个永远不会\n"
+"  被调用的 save hook。"
+
+msgid "## 5. Running the Feature"
+msgstr "## 5. 运行该特性"
+
+msgid "### 5.1 Mooncake Version"
+msgstr "### 5.1 Mooncake 版本"
+
+msgid "Install a Mooncake Python client that provides the following methods:"
+msgstr "安装提供以下方法的 Mooncake Python 客户端："
+
+msgid ""
+"If the currently published wheel does not provide these interfaces, build Mooncake from source after PR #2881 has\n"
+"been merged. The interfaces are checked automatically during startup."
+msgstr ""
+"如果当前发布的 wheel 未提供这些接口，请在 PR #2881 合并后从源码构建 Mooncake。\n"
+"这些接口会在启动期间自动检查。"
+
+msgid "### 5.2 Configuration Example"
+msgstr "### 5.2 配置示例"
+
+msgid ""
+"For the first hardware validation, start with TP=1, `layerwise_prefetch_layers=1`, and hybrid/CP/PP disabled. Then\n"
+"gradually increase the TP size, block count, and prefetch depth."
+msgstr ""
+"首次硬件验证时，请从 TP=1、`layerwise_prefetch_layers=1` 并禁用 hybrid/CP/PP 开始。然后\n"
+"逐步增大 TP size、block 数量和预取深度。"
+
+msgid ""
+"During integration testing, temporarily set `VLLM_ASCEND_KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG=1` to emit JSON audit logs for whole-key\n"
+"operations, per-layer ranges, and commits. Keep the default value of `0` during normal operation to avoid per-layer\n"
+"logging overhead."
+msgstr ""
+"在集成测试期间，可临时设置 `VLLM_ASCEND_KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG=1`，以输出 whole-key\n"
+"操作、逐层 range 和 commit 的 JSON 审计日志。正常运行时请保持默认值 `0`，以避免逐层\n"
+"日志开销。"
+
+msgid "## 6. Follow-up Optimization Recommendations"
+msgstr "## 6. 后续优化建议"
+
+msgid "### P0: Required Before Production"
+msgstr "### P0：生产环境前必须完成"
+
+msgid ""
+"1. **Pin a minimum Mooncake commit or version**\n"
+"   - Checking method availability prevents use of an outdated client but cannot detect incompatible ABI or return-code\n"
+"     semantics.\n"
+"   - Pin the exact commit containing PR #2881, or the first official release that contains it, in the installation\n"
+"     documentation and CI images."
+msgstr ""
+"1. **固定最低 Mooncake commit 或版本**\n"
+"   - 检查方法可用性可以防止使用过时的客户端，但无法检测不兼容的 ABI 或返回码\n"
+"     语义。\n"
+"   - 在安装文档和 CI 镜像中固定包含 PR #2881 的确切 commit，或包含该 PR 的首个官方\n"
+"     发布版本。"
+
+msgid ""
+"2. **Add a schema/layout fingerprint to the key namespace**\n"
+"   - For compatibility with the original PR, the current implementation still uses the model basename.\n"
+"   - Different revisions, data types, block sizes, or KV layouts with the same basename can collide.\n"
+"   - Add a stable digest of the tenant, model revision, data type, block size, TP layout, and schema version to the key."
+msgstr ""
+"2. **在 key 命名空间中添加 schema/layout 指纹**\n"
+"   - 为兼容原始 PR，当前实现仍使用模型 basename。\n"
+"   - 具有相同 basename 的不同 revision、数据类型、block size 或 KV layout 可能发生冲突。\n"
+"   - 将 tenant、模型 revision、数据类型、block size、TP layout 和 schema 版本的稳定摘要添加到 key 中。"
+
+msgid ""
+"3. **Add real-NPU E2E tests and fault injection**\n"
+"   - Cover at least TP=1/2, `kv_both`, P/D, chunked prefill, request preemption, single-key range failure,\n"
+"     commit failure, and Master restart.\n"
+"   - Verify that loading KV data produces exactly the same logits and tokens as local computation."
+msgstr ""
+"3. **添加真实 NPU 端到端测试与故障注入**\n"
+"   - 至少覆盖 TP=1/2、`kv_both`、P/D、chunked prefill、请求抢占、单 key range 失败、\n"
+"     commit 失败以及 Master 重启。\n"
+"   - 验证加载 KV 数据产生的 logits 和 tokens 与本地计算完全一致。"
+
+msgid "### P1: High-Impact Performance Improvements"
+msgstr "### P1：高影响力性能改进"
+
+msgid ""
+"1. **Adaptive prefetch depth**\n"
+"   - A fixed `layerwise_prefetch_layers` value cannot adapt to different per-layer compute times or network jitter.\n"
+"   - Dynamically control the window using the recent `transfer_time / compute_time` ratio, queue depth, and available\n"
+"     buffers."
+msgstr ""
+"1. **自适应预取深度**\n"
+"   - 固定的 `layerwise_prefetch_layers` 值无法适应不同的逐层计算时间或网络抖动。\n"
+"   - 使用近期的 `transfer_time / compute_time` 比值、队列深度和可用\n"
+"     buffer 动态控制窗口。"
+
+msgid ""
+"2. **Sliding session window**\n"
+"   - The current implementation opens sessions for every block in the batch at once. Long prompts can still create\n"
+"     many simultaneously active leases and sessions.\n"
+"   - Open sessions only for a future layer or block window, then advance the window after completion to reduce Master\n"
+"     state and timeout pressure."
+msgstr ""
+"2. **滑动 session 窗口**\n"
+"   - 当前实现会一次性为 batch 中的每个 block 打开 session。长 prompt 仍可能创建\n"
+"     大量同时活跃的 lease 和 session。\n"
+"   - 仅为未来的 layer 或 block 窗口打开 session，然后在完成后推进窗口，以减少 Master\n"
+"     状态和超时压力。"
+
+msgid ""
+"3. **Reduce per-layer Python list construction**\n"
+"   - The current implementation still creates `all_buffers`, `all_sizes`, and `all_offsets` for every layer.\n"
+"   - Precompute a range template for each layer and apply only vectorized block-ID address offsets. The descriptors\n"
+"     could eventually be cached in the C++/pybind layer."
+msgstr ""
+"3. **减少逐层 Python 列表构建**\n"
+"   - 当前实现仍会为每一层创建 `all_buffers`、`all_sizes` 和 `all_offsets`。\n"
+"   - 为每一层预计算 range 模板，仅应用向量化的 block-ID 地址偏移。这些描述符\n"
+"     最终可以缓存在 C++/pybind 层中。"
+
+msgid ""
+"4. **Incremental scheduler hit queries**\n"
+"   - The current implementation queries every candidate block before locating the first miss.\n"
+"   - Query in windows and stop at the first incomplete block to substantially reduce Master RPCs and key counts for\n"
+"     long prompts with low hit rates."
+msgstr ""
+"4. **增量式调度器命中查询**\n"
+"   - 当前实现会查询每一个候选 block，然后才定位到第一个未命中。\n"
+"   - 按窗口查询，并在第一个不完整的 block 处停止，从而大幅减少低命中率长 prompt 场景下的\n"
+"     Master RPC 和 key 数量。"
+
+msgid ""
+"5. **Dynamic batching based on total bytes and backend feedback**\n"
+"   - The current block and segment-byte limits are static.\n"
+"   - Jointly limit the total ranges and bytes per call, and adjust them automatically according to queue latency,\n"
+"     return codes, and bandwidth."
+msgstr ""
+"5. **基于总字节数和后端反馈的动态批处理**\n"
+"   - 当前的 block 和 segment-byte 限制是静态的。\n"
+"   - 联合限制每次调用的总 range 数和字节数，并根据队列延迟、\n"
+"     返回码和带宽自动调整。"
+
+msgid ""
+"6. **Local fan-out for shared keys**\n"
+"   - When multiple requests hit the same remote block, one key can currently produce multiple remote-read rows.\n"
+"   - Read into a shared staging buffer first, then copy to multiple target blocks locally. Whether this helps depends\n"
+"     on remote bandwidth relative to local H2D bandwidth."
+msgstr ""
+"6. **共享 key 的本地扇出**\n"
+"   - 当多个请求命中同一个远程 block 时，一个 key 目前可能产生多个远程读取行。\n"
+"   - 先读取到共享的 staging buffer，再在本地复制到多个目标 block。这是否有帮助取决于\n"
+"     远程带宽相对于本地 H2D 带宽的情况。"
+
+msgid "### P2: Further Evolution"
+msgstr "### P2：进一步演进"
+
+msgid ""
+"1. Support hybrid and multi-group layouts by recording the group layout in the key and object header, with an\n"
+"   independent completeness bitmap for each group.\n"
+"2. Support PP/PCP/DCP by encoding parallel coordinates in the key and having the scheduler validate the participating\n"
+"   rank set.\n"
+"3. Support a per-layer readiness bitmap so consumers can read completed early layers before the entire object becomes\n"
+"   `COMPLETE`. This requires visibility and consistency support from Mooncake and introduces substantial complexity.\n"
+"4. Record a schema, version, and checksum in the object header and perform an inexpensive compatibility check before\n"
+"   loading to prevent silent layout mismatches."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 通过在 key 和对象头中记录 group 布局，并为每个 group 维护独立的完整性位图，支持混合布局和多 group 布局。\n"
+"2. 通过在 key 中编码并行坐标，并由调度器校验参与的 rank 集合，支持 PP/PCP/DCP。\n"
+"3. 支持逐层就绪位图，使消费方可以在整个对象变为 `COMPLETE` 之前读取已完成的早期层。这需要 Mooncake 提供可见性和一致性支持，并会引入相当大的复杂度。\n"
+"4. 在对象头中记录 schema、版本和校验和，并在加载前执行低开销的兼容性检查，以防止出现静默的布局不匹配。"
+
+msgid "## 7. Validation Record"
+msgstr "## 7. 验证记录"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `py_compile`: Passed for the core changed files.\n"
+"- Ruff lint and format checks: Passed.\n"
+"- Relevant CPU mock pytest suite: `285 passed, 106 subtests passed`.\n"
+"- Strict `0`/`1` validation for `VLLM_ASCEND_KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG`: Passed.\n"
+"- Not yet completed: Tests with real NPUs, a real Mooncake client and Master, multi-node networking, and performance\n"
+"  benchmarks."
+msgstr ""
+"- `py_compile`：核心变更文件均通过。\n"
+"- Ruff lint 和格式检查：通过。\n"
+"- 相关 CPU mock pytest 测试套件：`285 passed, 106 subtests passed`。\n"
+"- `VLLM_ASCEND_KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG` 的严格 `0`/`1` 校验：通过。\n"
+"- 尚未完成：使用真实 NPU、真实 Mooncake 客户端和 Master、多节点网络的测试，以及性能基准测试。"
